title: What is the average overall rating of the players born before the year 1986
question:
What is the average overall rating of the players born before the year 1986?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: average overall rating = DIVIDE(SUM(overall_rating), COUNT(id)); born before the year 1986 refers to strftime('%Y', birthday) < '1986';

prediction.sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(pa.XCL_132) AS REAL) / COUNT(pa.XCL_128) AS average_overall_rating FROM Player_Attributes AS "pa" JOIN Player AS "p" ON "pa".XCL_130 = "p".XCL_122 WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', p.XCL_125) < '1986'
